sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Genjutsu (Auditory, Tactile), Symphonic Branch

system.description:
You enhance the power of your Auditory Ninja Tool by focusing your chakra through it, before striking out with it. Make a melee or ranged Taijutsu (or Genjutsu) attack using your Shinobi Instruments range. On a hit, you release a deafening tune of acoustics dealing your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage] + 3d8 psychic and forcing the affected creature to make a Wisdom saving throw.

Critical Success: The target suffers no additional effects.

Success: The target gains 1 rank of Dazzled until the end of their next turn.

Failure: The target is Deafened until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but a creature Deafened by this jutsu is Deafened for 1 minute. They remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns. On a success, they lose the Deafened condition.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the number of attacks you make by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the number of attacks you make by +1.
